segments.sn55.26:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati ābādhiko hoti dukkhito bāḷhagilāno.
segments.sn55.26:1.3: Atha kho anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati aññataraṃ purisaṃ āmantesi –
segments.sn55.26:1.4: “ehi tvaṃ, ambho purisa, yenāyasmā sāriputto tenupasaṅkama; upasaṅkamitvā mama vacanena āyasmato sāriputtassa pāde sirasā vanda –
segments.sn55.26:1.6: So āyasmato sāriputtassa pāde sirasā vandatī’ti.
segments.sn55.26:1.8: ‘sādhu kira, bhante, āyasmā sāriputto yena anāthapiṇḍikassa gahapatissa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkamatu anukampaṃ upādāyā’”ti.
segments.sn55.26:2.1: “Evaṃ, bhante”ti kho so puriso anāthapiṇḍikassa gahapatissa paṭissutvā yenāyasmā sāriputto tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so puriso āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn55.26:3.2: So āyasmato sāriputtassa pāde sirasā vandati.
segments.sn55.26:3.4: ‘sādhu kira, bhante, āyasmā sāriputto yena anāthapiṇḍikassa gahapatissa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkamatu anukampaṃ upādāyā’”ti.
segments.sn55.26:4.1: Atha kho āyasmā sāriputto pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya āyasmatā ānandena pacchāsamaṇena yena anāthapiṇḍikassa gahapatissa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi. Nisajja kho āyasmā sāriputto anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatiṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn55.26:4.2: “kacci te, gahapati, khamanīyaṃ kacci yāpanīyaṃ? Kacci dukkhā vedanā paṭikkamanti, no abhikkamanti; paṭikkamosānaṃ paññāyati, no abhikkamo”ti?
segments.sn55.26:4.3: “Na me, bhante, khamanīyaṃ, na yāpanīyaṃ. Bāḷhā me dukkhā vedanā abhikkamanti, no paṭikkamanti; abhikkamosānaṃ paññāyati, no paṭikkamo”ti.
segments.sn55.26:5.1: “Yathārūpena kho, gahapati, buddhe appasādena samannāgato assutavā puthujjano kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati tathārūpo te buddhe appasādo natthi.
segments.sn55.26:5.2: Atthi ca kho te, gahapati, buddhe aveccappasādo – itipi so bhagavā … pe … satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti.
segments.sn55.26:5.4: Tañca pana te buddhe aveccappasādaṃ attani samanupassato ṭhānaso vedanā paṭippassambheyya.
segments.sn55.26:6.1: “Yathārūpena kho, gahapati, dhamme appasādena samannāgato assutavā puthujjano kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati, tathārūpo te dhamme appasādo natthi.
segments.sn55.26:6.2: Atthi ca kho te, gahapati, dhamme aveccappasādo – svākkhāto bhagavatā dhammo … pe … paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhīti.
segments.sn55.26:6.4: Tañca pana te dhamme aveccappasādaṃ attani samanupassato ṭhānaso vedanā paṭippassambheyya.
segments.sn55.26:7.1: “Yathārūpena kho, gahapati, saṅghe appasādena samannāgato assutavā puthujjano kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati, tathārūpo te saṅghe appasādo natthi.
segments.sn55.26:7.2: Atthi ca kho te, gahapati, saṅghe aveccappasādo – suppaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho … pe … anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassāti.
segments.sn55.26:7.4: Tañca pana te saṅghe aveccappasādaṃ attani samanupassato ṭhānaso vedanā paṭippassambheyya.
segments.sn55.26:8.1: “Yathārūpena kho, gahapati, dussīlyena samannāgato assutavā puthujjano kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati, tathārūpaṃ te dussīlyaṃ natthi.
segments.sn55.26:8.2: Atthi ca kho te, gahapati, ariyakantāni sīlāni … pe … samādhisaṃvattanikāni.
segments.sn55.26:8.3: Tāni ca pana te ariyakantāni sīlāni attani samanupassato ṭhānaso vedanā paṭippassambheyya.
segments.sn55.26:9.1: “Yathārūpāya kho, gahapati, micchādiṭṭhiyā samannāgato assutavā puthujjano kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati, tathārūpā te micchādiṭṭhi natthi.
segments.sn55.26:9.2: Atthi ca kho te, gahapati, sammādiṭṭhi.
segments.sn55.26:9.3: Tañca pana te sammādiṭṭhiṃ attani samanupassato ṭhānaso vedanā paṭippassambheyya.
segments.sn55.26:10.1: “Yathārūpena kho, gahapati, micchāsaṅkappena samannāgato assutavā puthujjano kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati, tathārūpo te micchāsaṅkappo natthi.
segments.sn55.26:10.2: Atthi ca kho te, gahapati, sammāsaṅkappo.
segments.sn55.26:10.3: Tañca pana te sammāsaṅkappaṃ attani samanupassato ṭhānaso vedanā paṭippassambheyya.
segments.sn55.26:11.1: “Yathārūpāya kho, gahapati, micchāvācāya samannāgato assutavā puthujjano kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati, tathārūpā te micchāvācā natthi.
segments.sn55.26:11.2: Atthi ca kho te, gahapati, sammāvācā.
segments.sn55.26:11.3: Tañca pana te sammāvācaṃ attani samanupassato ṭhānaso vedanā paṭippassambheyya.
segments.sn55.26:12.1: “Yathārūpena kho, gahapati, micchākammantena samannāgato assutavā puthujjano kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati, tathārūpo te micchākammanto natthi.
segments.sn55.26:12.2: Atthi ca kho te, gahapati, sammākammanto.
segments.sn55.26:12.3: Tañca pana te sammākammantaṃ attani samanupassato ṭhānaso vedanā paṭippassambheyya.
segments.sn55.26:13.1: “Yathārūpena kho, gahapati, micchāājīvena samannāgato assutavā puthujjano kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati, tathārūpo te micchāājīvo natthi.
segments.sn55.26:13.2: Atthi ca kho te, gahapati, sammāājīvo.
segments.sn55.26:13.3: Tañca pana te sammāājīvaṃ attani samanupassato ṭhānaso vedanā paṭippassambheyya.
segments.sn55.26:14.1: “Yathārūpena kho, gahapati, micchāvāyāmena samannāgato assutavā puthujjano kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati, tathārūpo te micchāvāyāmo natthi.
segments.sn55.26:14.2: Atthi ca kho te, gahapati, sammāvāyāmo.
segments.sn55.26:14.3: Tañca pana te sammāvāyāmaṃ attani samanupassato ṭhānaso vedanā paṭippassambheyya.
segments.sn55.26:15.1: “Yathārūpāya kho, gahapati, micchāsatiyā samannāgato assutavā puthujjano kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati, tathārūpā te micchāsati natthi.
segments.sn55.26:15.2: Atthi ca kho te, gahapati, sammāsati.
segments.sn55.26:15.3: Tañca pana te sammāsatiṃ attani samanupassato ṭhānaso vedanā paṭippassambheyya.
segments.sn55.26:16.1: “Yathārūpena kho, gahapati, micchāsamādhinā samannāgato assutavā puthujjano kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati, tathārūpo te micchāsamādhi natthi.
segments.sn55.26:16.2: Atthi ca kho te, gahapati, sammāsamādhi.
segments.sn55.26:16.3: Tañca pana te sammāsamādhiṃ attani samanupassato ṭhānaso vedanā paṭippassambheyya.
segments.sn55.26:17.1: “Yathārūpena kho, gahapati, micchāñāṇena samannāgato assutavā puthujjano kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati, tathārūpaṃ te micchāñāṇaṃ natthi.
segments.sn55.26:17.2: Atthi ca kho te, gahapati, sammāñāṇaṃ.
segments.sn55.26:17.3: Tañca pana te sammāñāṇaṃ attani samanupassato ṭhānaso vedanā paṭippassambheyya.
segments.sn55.26:18.1: “Yathārūpāya kho, gahapati, micchāvimuttiyā samannāgato assutavā puthujjano kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati, tathārūpā te micchāvimutti natthi.
segments.sn55.26:18.2: Atthi ca kho te, gahapati, sammāvimutti.
segments.sn55.26:18.3: Tañca pana te sammāvimuttiṃ attani samanupassato ṭhānaso vedanā paṭippassambheyyā”ti.
segments.sn55.26:19.1: Atha kho anāthapiṇḍikassa gahapatissa ṭhānaso vedanā paṭippassambhiṃsu.
segments.sn55.26:19.2: Atha kho anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati āyasmantañca sāriputtaṃ āyasmantañca ānandaṃ sakeneva thālipākena parivisi.
segments.sn55.26:19.3: Atha kho anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ bhuttāviṃ onītapattapāṇiṃ aññataraṃ nīcāsanaṃ gahetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
segments.sn55.26:19.4: Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatiṃ āyasmā sāriputto imāhi gāthāhi anumodi –
segments.sn55.26:21.3: Adaliddoti [adaḷiddoti (sī. syā. kaṃ.)] taṃ āhu, amoghaṃ tassa jīvitaṃ.
segments.sn55.26:23.1: Atha kho āyasmā sāriputto anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatiṃ imāhi gāthāhi anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi.
segments.sn55.26:24.1: Atha kho āyasmā ānando yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ bhagavā etadavoca –
segments.sn55.26:24.2: “handa! Kuto nu tvaṃ, ānanda, āgacchasi divādivassā”ti?
segments.sn55.26:24.3: “Āyasmatā, bhante, sāriputtena anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati iminā ca iminā ca ovādena ovadito”ti.
segments.sn55.26:24.5: mahāpañño, ānanda, sāriputto, yatra hi nāma cattāri sotāpattiyaṅgāni dasahākārehi vibhajissatī”ti.

lines: Chaṭṭhe ṭhānaso vedanā paṭippassambheyyāti khaṇena vedanā paṭippassambheyya.
Taṃ pana aniyyānikaṃ “niyyānikan”ti paccavekkhaṇavasena pavatteyyāti āha “micchāpaccavekkhaṇenā”ti.
